name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer headquartered in Reno, Nevada, focused on mineral properties in Nevada and Idaho. The company uses a dual-track business model combining active exploration on its own properties — including the Lapon Canyon, Loman, Agai-Pah, and Swales projects in Nevada and the Belshazzar project in Idaho — with the acquisition of royalty interests. It is in the early exploration stage, conducting reverse circulation drill programs to identify economic gold mineralization.
